findings.title: FilterExpression create/update divergence not recorded in DIVERGENCES
findings.problem: ListenerCreateHelper reads FilterExpression from the listener-level request bag (request.ResourceProperties?.Get("FilterExpression")) inside the per-destination Put loop, while ListenerRequestValidator and ListenerUpdateHelper read it per inline destination (d.Get/Value!["FilterExpression"]). The design models filterExpression per-destination (correct for validator + update + DynamoDbHelper round-trip), but this create-vs-update control-plane inconsistency is not on the DIVERGENCES hand-off list.
findings.fix: Add a divergence entry (e.g. D-14) noting ListenerCreateHelper reads FilterExpression at listener level while the validator/update read it per inline destination; L1 keeps filterExpression on the inline destination (correct per validator + update); the create-path mismatch is a control-plane bug for follow-up. No L1 API/wire change (no example uses FilterExpression).

findings.title: attrDestinationNames list-token consumption caveat unstated
findings.location: design.md CfnListener output attributes, 'Getter return types' paragraph
findings.problem: attrDestinationNames is correctly modeled as a string-list token via Fn.getAtt(...).toStringList() (response.Data["DestinationNames"] is a JSON array; consumed via Fn::Select in event-bridge/coap-demo/blink/radius). The design does not state that, unlike attrPort, a custom-resource list GetAtt token must be consumed with list-aware intrinsics (Fn::Select/Fn::Join) and not inside an Fn::Sub scalar string context.
findings.fix: Add a sentence to the attrDestinationNames note: it is a list token; consume with Fn.select/Fn.join, not inside an Fn.sub string interpolation. No API change.
